1.10.0: Coach lines and songs messages now show in Spanish, and phone feedback no longer leaves an empty strip mid-session.
1.11.0: Starter songs for every instrument and practice grooves on the drum kit, with a per-song speed slider and playback of your try. A metronome, a consistency record in place of streaks, and lessons that stay inside your MIDI keyboard's range. Settings can now erase all your data, and a backup shows its date before you restore it.
1.12.0: Timed exercises on every instrument now show when to play: a beat number, a line that crosses each note on time, and a ring that closes on each drum. The Windows Store app can use a MIDI drum kit again, and the app says why a kit did not connect. A new drum step grades the right drums in order with no clock, and a failed drum bar repeats up to 3 times.
1.12.1: Timed exercises now show when to play: a beat number, a line that crosses each note on time, and a ring that closes on each drum. One drum hit now counts once, a hard kick no longer also reads as a snare or tom, and kit set-up can go back and relearn a pad. The Store app can use a MIDI kit again and says why a kit did not connect. A new drum step grades the right drums in order with no clock, and a failed drum bar gets up to 3 tries.
1.12.2: A song ID from a restored backup can no longer run as page code. Stop playing now really stops a MIDI keyboard. MIDI files keep their tempo, time signature and key changes. Restoring a backup carries on past a bad song and tells you. Lessons skip bars with no notes. A challenge or band pack too big to reopen is refused when you make it, and a band pack that unpacks past 20 MB is refused when you open it.
1.12.3: A repeat of the same note on a guitar now counts at an ordinary volume. Plucked instruments show GET READY before a note's timer starts, say when a note is from memory with no dot, and mark what the mic hears with hollow rings at the octave it hears. The two open E strings read Low E and High E. On keyboard level 13, a MIDI keyboard now needs both keys pressed together.
